dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Rag and Bone Shop. You need it, we got it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to buy something.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Have you got enough Coupons?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just browsing...

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Feel free to look at anything. But some stuff has been reserved already, so don't go breaking anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have anything for free?

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Haha! You're a real funny one.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Go see Wolsey, if you haven't gotten your Welfare Meal yet today. He'll give you free food and a free smile. The only thing free here is the air you're breathing.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: The Rag and Bone Shop. You need it, we got it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to buy something.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Choose anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where do you get your goods from?

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: No comment.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: But all my goods are guaranteed safe, from legit sources, and my prices are fair. That's all I can say.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you take orders?

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Depends on who's ordering what. You'll understand that I can't be completely frank with you.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: The Rag and Bone Shop. You need it, we got it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to buy something.

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Haven't got anything worth looking at right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me shop!

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: We really haven't got anything worth looking at right now!

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Last time you and Little Skylark bought all my stock. Then I had problems restocking. All my regulars were complaining they couldn't even get a bottle of Fonta. The reputational damage...

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Anyway, there's nothing here worth your time. I suggest you try elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay then...

dialogues.speaker: Alvard
dialogues.text: Sorry. Take care.
